name: Data Preview Cages Track
implementation_notes: Full rewrite (entity-catalog v3, 2026-08-19): DataPreviewCagesTrackView.vue mirrors DataPreviewWeighbridgeView.vue/DataPreviewGradingView.vue's dual-mode (list+filter+detail) pattern, restructured for cages_track_record's new v3 fields (tippler_start_time/tippler_stop_time/cages_out/cages_tipped/note) and the cages_tipped_time grid's full restructure (tipped_hour/checked_cage_numbers/total_cages/cages_remain)

cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts gained getAllRecords(userId) — simple SELECT * WHERE created_by = ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC, mirrors gradingRecordRepo.ts's own getAllRecords(); never touches cages_tipped_time (detail mode loads child rows separately via getDraftWithTippedTimes(), reused unmodified from screen-012)

Date filter compares against cages_track_record.date.slice(0, 10) — date is a full local datetime string (set via nowLocalDateTimeString() in FormCagesTrackView.vue), not a plain date column, so this mirrors DataPreviewWeighbridgeView.vue's arrival_datetime slice-based filter rather than DataPreviewGradingView.vue's exact-match date filter. Independently verified against localSchema.ts's CREATE_CAGES_TRACK_RECORD DDL (date TEXT) and the actual write site in FormCagesTrackView.vue

checked_cage_numbers (comma-separated TEXT, e.g. "1,3,5") parsed client-side by checkedCagesDisplay() into a readable "Cage 1, Cage 3, Cage 5" list; tipped_hour formatted as HH:00 via hourLabel() (copied verbatim from FormCagesTrackView.vue's own helper). total_cages/cages_remain rendered exactly as stored, never recomputed — historical data, matching the 'computed then persisted' pattern used throughout this station

Checked By/Acknowledged By ARE shown in detail mode (unlike Weighbridge/Grading, which omit them) — consistent with Form Cages Track's own decision to keep both fields; no role restriction on viewing, only on editing (already enforced in the Form)

'Inputted By' has no dedicated cages_track_record column (created_by is a user id, no local user-name lookup table exists) — rendered from authStore.currentUser?.name, same source FormCagesTrackView.vue's own 'Inputted By' field uses; valid because detail mode is only ever reached via this screen's own getAllRecords(userId)-scoped list (always the current user's own records)
This closes the entire Cages Track station overhaul (screens 009/012/015) on top of entity-catalog v3

Independently re-verified beyond the agent's own report (established practice this session after the screen-012 agent stall incident): full mobile vitest suite 385/385 passing across 20 files; cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts screen-009 functions (getProgressSummary/getTodaySummary/getDrafts/createDraft/resumeDraft/pauseDraft/deleteDraft) confirmed still present/untouched (36 grep matches) after the getAllRecords() addition; full Playwright suite 101/101 passing across the whole app (Weighbridge/Grading/Cages Track/Station List/Home/Auth), no regressions; DataPreviewCagesTrackView.vue read in full and confirmed correct (date-filter slice rationale cross-checked against localSchema.ts's actual DDL and FormCagesTrackView.vue's write site, not just the component's own comment); DataPreviewCagesTrackView.spec.ts read in full and confirmed to genuinely exercise the component's real logic (list/detail mode, filters, badge mapping, row-tap routing, watch()-driven route reactivity, breadcrumb/hamburger) rather than being superficial

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): mode detail memasang RecordVerificationActions (station-type='cages-track', local-table='cages_track_record') yang memanggil PATCH /api/records/cages-track/{server_id}/verification; backend RecordVerificationService::setVerification menerapkan peran + cakupan mill lalu assertPeriodOpenForWrite (EnforcesPeriodLock) atas `date` record sebelum menulis — periode stasiun tidak terbuka / tanggal di luar rentang → 422 PERIOD_CLOSED tanpa perubahan kolom; komponen menampilkan pesan server dan baris lokal tidak diperbarui (UPDATE lokal hanya setelah sukses); offline → pesan 'Butuh koneksi internet untuk verifikasi'. Tercakup oleh backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (blok 'kunci periode pada jalur verifikasi') dan backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php; mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts mencakup galat offline tetapi belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus.

REVISI v5 (2026-10-03, sinkronisasi catatan uji — kode tidak diubah): celah 'recordVerification.spec.ts belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus' pada catatan REVISI kunci periode di atas kini TERTUTUP — mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts menambah 'shows the period-lock (422 PERIOD_CLOSED) message verbatim as an error and leaves the local row untouched' untuk komponen bersama RecordVerificationActions yang dipasang di mode detail layar ini: pesan server 422 PERIOD_CLOSED ditampilkan apa adanya sebagai galat dan baris lokal tidak di-UPDATE. Uji hijau.

REVISI (2026-10-03, run penuh Playwright mobile 430 lulus / 0 gagal): mobile/tests/e2e/data-preview-cages-track.spec.ts 11/11 lulus (test_results.browser sebelumnya mencatat 101 = hitungan seluruh suite, kini hitungan spec layar ini). Perbaikan spec (drift, bukan cacat aplikasi): mode detail kini meng-assert blok status verifikasi RecordVerificationStatus (Checked By & Acknowledged By, nama dari kolom *_by_name) alih-alih input berisi nama; cek negatif not.toHaveURL glob '**/…' diganti RegExp.

known_issues.description: MonitorCagesTrackView.vue's (screen-009) 'Load Data' button navigates to this screen with no id param, which correctly lands on LIST mode — same resolution as screen-007/013 (Weighbridge) and screen-008/014 (Grading). Out of this screen's implementation scope; MonitorCagesTrackView.vue was not modified here.
